Based on the three frames provided:

*   **Persistence:** The bright white elongated streaks (bullet tracers) are **transient**. They **do not** stay in the same place across all three frames. 
    *   In the **first frame**, there are two prominent, slightly curved white streaks visible in the background on the right side of the screen.
    *   In the **second frame**, these streaks have completely **vanished**.
    *   In the **third frame**, a new, single prominent white streak has appeared near the bottom center/right of the screen.

*   **Shape and Count:** Yes, the streaks in the first frame appear slightly **curved like an arc**. There are **not** exactly two prominent ones across all frames; there are two in the first frame, zero in the second, and one in the third.

**Description of the two most prominent streaks' positions in each frame:**
*   **Frame 1:** Two prominent, curved white streaks are located in the background on the **right side** of the image, appearing to arc upwards and to the right behind the menu.
*   **Frame 2:** There are **no** prominent white streaks visible; the background is clear of tracers.
*   **Frame 3:** One prominent, straight/vertical white streak is located in the lower portion of the screen, slightly to the **right of the center**, extending upwards from the bottom edge.
